frameShift.name: Frame Shift
frameShift.prompt:
Create realistic, production-quality UI art direction with exceptional typography, purposeful spacing and bespoke photographic imagery. Design ONE coherent new direction named FRAME SHIFT for MaxVideoAI, the existing AI image/video creation and model comparison platform. This is a radical new visual proposal, not a clone.

DELIVERABLE: a high-resolution 2400 x 1800 landscape art-direction board for this ONE direction: a large desktop homepage crop (1440px design width) on the left, a properly recomposed mobile webpage crop (390px design width) on the right, and three large chronological motion keyframes under the desktop. Quiet board labels DESKTOP, MOBILE, SCROLL STUDY. No device bezels, no browser chrome. The desktop and mobile must be big and legible; minimize explanatory prose. The storyboard is the SAME design advancing through one sequence, not different visual alternatives.

GROUNDING: Attached screenshots are the real MaxVideoAI homepage and published scorecard. Use real brand identity and product purpose; do not imitate their boxes or their imagery. This brief deliberately expands beyond cinema: customers create cinematic shots, TikTok/reels, commercial ads, and animated products for websites. Never imply the platform automatically publishes to TikTok or builds the client's website. Current date 2026-09-10. English master.

VISUAL IDEA: an extraordinary contemporary graphic design studio meets an AI creation tool. Chalk-white page, very dark ink, small electric-cobalt accents. Oversized impeccably kerned slightly condensed sans-serif type, Swiss editorial alignment, expressive image silhouettes and unusual compositions, very fine production detail. The invention is in the composition and the way formats transform, not decorative effects. Use strong cutout photographs of real objects with realistic edge detail, not flat icons. Restrained corners, almost no container borders; no repeated rounded cards, no card within card, no glassmorphism, no gradient blobs, no generic SaaS benefit grid. At most two type families. Body at 16px equivalent. No huge wasteful gaps.

DESKTOP: slim exquisite navigation with authentic MaxVideoAI brand from reference, Models, Compare, Connect, Pricing, small Create button. Massive asymmetric headline 'One idea. Every format.' with a cobalt punctuation detail; useful small copy 'AI images and video for films, feeds and product pages.' Primary 'Start creating', secondary 'Explore examples'. Directly below/alongside the headline, compose three unequal photographic apertures as a single striking collage: wide cinematic landscape of a solitary silver vehicle under a huge pink dusk sky; vertical photograph of a real dancer making a sharp movement in cobalt light; sculptural cutout glossy orange over-ear headphones rotating above their own soft realistic shadow, protruding beyond a clean square photographic crop. Place the headphones so their curved headband interacts with the typography's negative space without obscuring reading. Three restrained labels 'Film', 'Social', 'Product'. Different crops, coherent photographic craft, no corporate stock.
Below this major composition show the beginning of a finely aligned, unboxed product chooser: heading 'Find your model.' with named model identities Kling / Seedance / MiniMax / Wan / LTX. Include a modest meaningful 'Compare models' action, and a thin subsequent teaser 'Your project, connected.' The entire page must clearly remain a creation product, not a design agency portfolio. Do not attribute generated concept photos to models. Small disclosure 'Concept imagery' once.

MOBILE: genuinely redesign the composition, don't scale down desktop. Brand and simple menu, 3-line readable headline, 44px-high primary and secondary actions then a large carefully cropped orange headphone image and one adjacent smaller vertical dancer crop; next visible row shows Films / Social / Products as readable text navigation. Keep a clear accessible CTA and poster before ancillary links. Touch-friendly spacing, no microscopic desktop menu.

THREE STORYBOARD FRAMES across bottom: SAME orange headphones and cobalt registration marks. First: clean static product reference inside a square. Second: the identical headphones turn three-quarter view while a portrait aperture opens beside them, revealing a human hand lifting the SAME orange headphones. Third: three separated final compositions: widescreen close-up advertising shot, vertical lifestyle clip, square clean product loop. Each is separately art-directed, not a stretched source photo. Captions 'Reference', 'Direct the shot', 'Choose the format'. A discreet annotation 'Planned scroll sequence · illustrative outputs' prevents automatic one-click batch claims. Show actual composition changes, purposeful depth and beautiful object edges; no arbitrary floating UI windows.

The board should feel radically more graphic and fine than a film still with a headline. Everything must look compelling paused, with crisp alignments, crafted buttons and exceptionally controlled image color. Do not invent scores, badges, customer logos, prices or guarantees.

motionAtlas.name: The Motion Atlas
motionAtlas.prompt:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with exceptional visual craft. Produce ONE distinct art direction named THE MOTION ATLAS for MaxVideoAI, an existing multi-model AI image/video creation and comparison platform. Make it original, graphic, cinematic AND useful to advertising, social media and website creators. It must not look like a movie streaming service or a generic AI dashboard.

DELIVERABLE: one high-resolution 2400 x 1800 landscape direction board: a dominant desktop homepage crop at a 1440px design width on the left, a fully recomposed 390px mobile webpage on the right, and three readable motion storyboard keyframes under the desktop. This is one cohesive design with responsive and sequential supporting views, NOT multiple ideas. Small external board labels DESKTOP, MOBILE, SCROLL STUDY. No phone/bezel/browser chrome, no 3D device mockup, no decorative shadows around page captures. Keep the designs large, not tiny postage stamps. English UI master, current date 2026-09-10.

REFERENCE ROLE: attached real MaxVideoAI homepage establishes brand and product purpose; attached real comparison screen establishes the importance of legible criteria and editorial scores. Completely rethink presentation; do not copy the boxed layout, ochre coats or prices.

VISUAL SYSTEM: a sophisticated visual atlas / contemporary moving-image exhibition, dark oxford ink with warm white typography, luminous coral-red fine focus markers and restrained warm gray calibration lines. Precise functional typography inspired by a professional editorial tool; big expressive sans-serif headline, quiet monospaced indices, no more than two fonts. Open edge-to-edge imagery, split alignments, extremely fine lines, exact spacing, no gratuitous rounded containers. Image light and color provide richness; no synthetic neon gradients, futuristic HUD, purple blobs, chrome cubes, diagonal flying windows or indistinct microtext. Density from meaningful imagery and generous readable data, not feature badges. Avoid empty voids.

DESKTOP COMPOSITION: fine masthead with real MaxVideoAI name/mark and Models / Compare / Connect / Pricing, a white 'Create a video' button. A striking asymmetric opening: headline occupying one-third 'Find the look. Make it move.' Supporting readable copy 'AI video for films, feeds and product pages.' Primary 'Create a video', secondary 'See examples'. Beside and below the text, a LARGE continuous cinematic image gallery occupying two-thirds, built from three precisely aligned unequal apertures at different depths: a widescreen futuristic silver car crossing a desert with photographic film lighting; an extremely tactile vertical high-speed beauty advertising shot of a vivid red lipstick and suspended translucent liquid; a portrait dancer caught mid-turn in daylight, clean fashion-commercial imagery. They are curated examples of different use cases, not outputs credited to a particular model. Fine captions 'Cinematic', 'Product', 'Social'. One frame occupies the foreground and neighboring frames recede slightly with believable perspective; no floating browser panels, no carousel card chrome. A thin coral focus cursor aligns image, category and model chooser on a shared baseline.

The NEXT substantial section is a truly refined comparison instrument on the SAME dark surface, heading 'Choose with evidence.' Two clean identities 'Kling 3 Pro' and 'Seedance 2.5', a compact exact comparison table with fine aligned tick marks, solid coral vs ivory bars, strong readable numbers. EXACT data only: Prompt adherence 8.6 / 9.1; Visual quality 8.4 / 9.2; Motion realism 8.4 / 9.2. Label 'MaxVideoAI editorial scores / 10'. Action 'Read the comparison'. Do not attach scores to generated photos or invent a winner, do not say same prompt. Thin text link 'Create with your assistant' keeps Connect present. Model names Kling / Seedance / MiniMax / Wan / LTX form a quiet precise baseline, not a decorative endless logo cloud.

MOBILE: native-feeling responsive webpage; brand, simple menu, large two/three-line headline, comfortable CTA and secondary action followed immediately by one strong visual frame. Adjacent work is glimpsed only enough to suggest swiping. Three clear use-case names. Below, show the comparison condensed to one criterion row with both names and both values clearly readable at mobile size, not a shrunken desktop table. No hover-only affordances. No sidebar.

STORYBOARD BOTTOM: demonstrate the COMPARISON animation with rigor and beauty. Keyframe 'Enter': two large wordmarks Kling 3 Pro and Seedance 2.5 settle into two aligned columns. Keyframe 'Reveal': a thin coral reading line travels downward over the THREE same criterion rows; number glyphs stay unchanged while bars unmask to their exact lengths. Keyframe 'Read': complete stable scorecard with all six exact numbers and 'Read the comparison'. The first frame can show main values already; NEVER show made-up changing scores, race, slot-machine counters or ranking flips. Motion should reveal the structure, not falsify evidence. External caption 'Scroll reveals the comparison. Scores stay fixed.' All final-state text is readable and the result looks as polished as a serious instrument.

Exceptionally precise buttons, baselines, separators, crops and depth. No awards, fake customer logos, fabricated metrics or price claims. Small 'Concept imagery' distinguishes generated study photos. Final image must be graphic and product-minded, not merely a dark photograph with white headline.

fromTheSource.name: From the Source
fromTheSource.prompt:
Create a realistic, production-quality, unusually beautiful UI art direction for the existing MaxVideoAI platform. ONE coherent direction named FROM THE SOURCE. It must unite cinema craft, advertising, social content, web product animation and AI-assisted creation. The user rejects generic templates, excessive boxes, vague 3D decoration and film-portfolio styling. Invent a more distinctive, precise graphic language.

DELIVERABLE: one high-resolution 2400 x 1800 landscape art-direction board. A large desktop homepage crop (1440px design width) left, a genuinely recomposed mobile webpage (390px design width) right, and three chronological frames of the SAME Connect workflow underneath the desktop. One design, not three options. Quiet board labels DESKTOP, MOBILE, SCROLL STUDY. Large legible designs, no device bezel, phone chrome, floating browser frames or decorative shadow around mockups. English master. Date anchor 2026-09-10, no fabricated statistics or dates.

GROUNDING: attached live MaxVideoAI homepage supplies brand identity and real purpose; scorecard attachment supplies comparison clarity. They are product references, NOT visual templates. Do not reuse their ochre-coat subjects, prices or nested boxes.

ART DIRECTION: a contemporary campaign book brought to life by an AI creation tool. Warm pale alabaster, rich aubergine ink and vibrant tangerine in the imagery. Very carefully drawn oversize elegant grotesk typography contrasted with one fine expressive italic serif word; no more than two fonts. Strong optical spacing, dramatic scale change, editorial asymmetry. Photorealistic materiality: rippled amber glass, embossed paper, liquid caustics, detailed fruit peel. Beautiful physically grounded cutouts and contact shadows belong to the scene, not drop shadows on UI. No beige blandness, no torn scrapbook, no generic corporate illustration, no pills, no card grid, no neon networks, no glowing AI brain. Discreet graphic registration brackets repeat as a subtle identity.

DESKTOP: narrow refined MaxVideoAI masthead using source mark, Models / Compare / Connect / Pricing, small high-contrast 'Start creating'. Lead with a very strong headline 'Your world. In motion.' and concise explanation 'Create AI video from an idea, an image or your project.' Primary 'Create a video', secondary 'Explore examples'. Under this, an arresting integrated editorial photographic composition: a large perfectly lit ribbed AMBER GLASS BOTANICAL SODA bottle with a small cream label reading 'Morrow', standing on a reflective pale surface, citrus peel suspended beside it with credible fine detail. Product is ONE illustrative campaign, not MaxVideoAI's own product. Its silhouette overlaps the negative space between a tall portrait commercial frame of a person pouring the SAME soda, and a landscape sun-drenched film close-up of liquid in the SAME glass. Image crops and huge typography form a cohesive graphic composition; no independent rectangular card containers. Three subtle captions signal applications 'Brand film', 'Social cut', 'Website loop'. Small 'Illustrative campaign' disclosure.

Directly below, a visually significant Connect chapter 'From your site to your next video.' Show a flat small editorial website fragment for the SAME illustrative Morrow brand on the left: cream label, amber bottle and its botanical ingredients; a very short, perfectly typeset creative plan in the middle; a large moving-image output still on the right continuing the SAME bottle, colors and scene. Use a single shared editorial baseline and controlled photographic overlap to suggest continuity, NOT a fake computer screen emitting floating cards. Brief copy 'Bring your project to Claude, Codex or ChatGPT.' Show 'Review the plan and price' as a legible intermediate checkpoint. CTA 'Connect your assistant'. AI is expressed through this useful relationship, not a sci-fi icon. Keep a visible graceful subsequent row 'Find the right model' / Kling / Seedance / MiniMax / Wan / LTX / 'Compare models'. No fabricated ratings or endorsement logos.

MOBILE: rebuild the hierarchy at 390px; mark and menu, bold 3-line headline, thumb-friendly 44px-plus primary and secondary actions, then a magnificent portrait crop of the SAME amber bottle and reflected light. Use-case labels compact and readable. Immediately after, a short Connect benefit and first source/plan step arranged vertically, not shrunken three-column desktop. Text must be crisp and comfortable. No massive blank band, no horizontally trapped scroll.

THREE KEYFRAMES BOTTOM for Connect: 'Your source': show the flat Morrow product-page fragment with bottle, orange peel and concise brand text. 'Your direction': the SAME material separates into a precisely aligned 3-shot board: amber texture close-up, pouring action, hero bottle; visible small checkpoint 'Review plan & price'. 'Your video': a wide ad frame plus a tall social composition and a clean square product-loop still using the SAME bottle, recognizable label, location and ingredients. A discreet external note says 'Illustrative sequence · formats created as separate outputs'. The origin must visibly survive the transformation, and output compositions genuinely evolve; no implication of automatic publishing, automatic website editing or a finished one-click campaign service.

This is a new graphic homepage concept for a general AI image/video product, not a soda store. The service navigation, creation actions and Connect chapter must be unmistakable. At most two fonts, 16px-equivalent body text, no unreadable tiny inventories. Every line, button, edge, crop and overlap must look deliberately finished.
